title: Local sessions get every allow, autoMode entry and setting that cloud sessions get, on Mac and Windows
why: The owner is never at the local keyboard, so local sessions that stop to ask are worse than cloud ones that do not.
source: Consultant 20:29 CST Nov 13, quoting the owner's ruling 20:28 CST (chat; triage did not see it). Premise rejected: session-tiers line 123 (install.sh adds merge/cloud_allow.json, 3 merge allows, to cloud settings only), on the assumption that someone is at the local keyboard (consultant's read, unchecked by triage).
note: Filed 20:29 CST Nov 13. Owner ruling (own-local-autonomy-like-cloud): local should have always been as autonomous as the cloud; he gets asked to create sessions locally and not in the cloud. Scope: every allow, autoMode entry and setting that cloud sessions get, local sessions get too, on Mac and Windows; the role-file and merge-role-proof guards still bound who merges. Rewrite session-tiers line 123 in place (the decision file is on main; a lane edits it). Also include the create_session prompt he sees locally: unmeasured, triage does not have its text; the lane gets it from the owner or his Mac session. Known cloud-only source: merge/cloud_allow.json lines 4-6 (merge * --confirm, merge * --confirm *, merge --role batch-runner), read by triage this window. Related: local-allow-goes-global, reinstall-from-stable-allow. A permission change: lane first diffs cloud against local settings, then test-author red case, builder, reviewer. Needs a lane (consultant asked the coordinator). Coordinator 20:31 CST Nov 13 (20:30): lane started, session_013NEJL2xbx9cwQLXuRSA66d (Sonnet, medium): diff what install.sh gives cloud against local, give local every allow and mode cloud has, keep the merge-role-proof guard and role file as the merge bound, rewrite session-tiers line 123 in place, test that a local install carries each cloud allow. Overlaps lane local-allow-goes-global and PR #3323; they coordinate through step notes only. Consultant 20:33 CST Nov 13 (20:33): owner question 20:31 CST, "When a local session asks you before it creates a session, what does the prompt say? Paste it or a screenshot", was posted as item 796 and withdrawn at 20:32 before he answered; item 796 closed. The lane finds the prompt itself by diffing the cloud and local settings and reading the Mac session logs; it asks the owner only if that read fails, and then names the check it ran.
